_metadata.description: Manifest for rebuilding biomarker_mapping.json from split source YAML files.
_metadata.context: v6 Methods / Exposure integration module: 'The complete mapping of Tier 2 lifestyle multipliers to their primary biomarker data sources, published concentration ranges, and derived [S]/Km ratios.'
_metadata.source_note: Master manifest for the split biomarker registry. Edit the owning source file, then rebuild and compare.
update_workflow: Edit the source YAML that owns the biomarker row.
Keep each biomarker in exactly one source file.
Run make build-biomarker-mapping to rebuild biomarker_mapping.json.
Run make compare-biomarker-mapping to diff the rebuilt JSON against biomarker_mapping_old.json.
Run make check-biomarker-mapping and pytest before publishing.

references: CDC National Exposure Report PAH metabolites: urinary 1-hydroxypyrene, NHANES 2003-2010
CDC NHANES 2003-2004 OH-PAH urine lab method (1-hydroxypyrene)
PMID 23885861 Bouchard & Viau 1999 urinary 1-hydroxypyrene PAH biomonitoring review

entries.provenance_note: Urinary 1-hydroxypyrene supports PAH/pyrene exposure, not CYP1A1-specific enzyme activity. CYP1A1 and Km_uM are retained as PAH activation normalization parameters from the flux model. Step 7: no Pyrene Carcinogen node, so this row joins group_pahs only.

references: CDC NHANES 2003-2004 urinary total and speciated arsenic data file
CDC NHANES 2003-2004 urine total arsenic lab method
ATSDR Toxicological Profile for Arsenic 2007
entries.provenance_note: Urinary total arsenic supports arsenic exposure but includes organic seafood arsenicals unless speciated. AS3MT and Km_uM are inorganic-arsenic methylation normalization parameters. Step 7: total urinary arsenic includes seafood organoarsenicals and is not speciated inorganic arsenic, so it is not joined to ArsenicInorganic or to group_heavy_metals. Joined to group_heavy_metals by curator decision. ArsenicOrganic is not a graph node, so carcinogen_id is not set.
